title: appointments.availability.day_opening
description: The date to ask about, and nothing else (appointments#105): the opening hours are read from the hub by the runtime (`reads`), never sent by the caller — hours a caller supplies are hours a caller can forge.

date.description: The business's own calendar date (`2026-08-03`), the same key a special day or an override is written under. Not an instant: there is no clock to cross.
